Responsible for protocol writing and execution (field verification), and development of summary reports at client sites. jobgether-jobgether:lever:aaeedfbf-2c74-.title: Lead Site Reliability Engineer - Imunify Reliability Platform
jobgether-jobgether:lever:aaeedfbf-2c74-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Lead Site Reliability Engineer - Imunify Reliability Platform based in South Africa. This is a greenfield SRE leadership opportunity within a large-scale, security-focused product environment. You will define what “healthy” means across roughly 70 components spanning cloud services and customer-hosted agents. You will establish SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, monitoring standards, alerting, and escalation practices from the ground up. Your work will directly improve the ability to detect silent security-control degradation before it becomes a widespread customer-impacting issue. You will collaborate closely with engineering leads and senior engineers while building the telemetry and reliability platform yourself. The environment is remote-first, async, technically demanding, and focused on measurable outcomes rather than dashboards for their own sake. This is an opportunity to shape the reliability culture and foundations of a major security product. Define and establish meaningful SLIs for approximately 70 product components, working with squad leads and senior engineers to agree on ownership, measurement, tiering, SLOs, and error budgets. Develop a reliability taxonomy covering service availability and latency, fleet reachability and configuration convergence, security-control efficacy, artifact delivery, and telemetry pipeline health. Ensure reliability indicators are independently measurable and cannot be disabled by the same failure they are intended to detect. Design and build the telemetry collection pipeline for customer-hosted agents and cloud services, balancing push-based collection, sampling, privacy constraints, data quality, and cardinality. Extend instrumentation across Python, Go, and Rust components in collaboration with product engineering teams. Consolidate existing dashboards, queries, and reporting mechanisms into a smaller, more reliable observability platform, retiring tooling that does not provide meaningful operational value. Implement symptom-based, SLO-driven alerting with multi-window burn-rate principles and clear page, ticket, and dashboard classifications. Ensure every production alert has a defined owner, documented failure mode, and actionable runbook. Establish ongoing alert-quality practices, including periodic reviews, measurable actionable-alert rates, and deliberate removal of unnecessary alerts. Build a machine-readable ownership and escalation model that routes incidents to the appropriate engineering squads. Establish severity definitions, acknowledgement expectations, follow-the-sun escalation practices, and clean handoff procedures across multiple time zones. Strengthen incident command and blameless postmortem practices, including reliable timelines, ownership, and follow-through on corrective actions. Coach engineering squads to own their own operational responsibilities and paging rather than becoming a centralized buffer for other teams' alerts. Deliver measurable reliability outcomes over the first year, including complete SLI ownership, production telemetry, tiered alerting, squad on-call adoption, and a significant reduction in the time required to detect silent security-control degradation. Requirements Substantial production engineering or SRE experience, including experience defining and implementing an SLO framework rather than simply operating within an existing one. Strong Python skills and the ability to read and modify Go or Rust code when implementing instrumentation and reliability improvements. Strong hands-on experience with time-series and event telemetry at scale, including Prometheus/OpenMetrics, Grafana, Alertmanager-class routing systems, and columnar or high-cardinality data stores such as ClickHouse or equivalent technologies. jobgether-jobgether:lever:c2a402f3-a3d8-.title: Property Management Account Manager
jobgether-jobgether:lever:c2a402f3-a3d8-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Property Management Account Manager based in Israel. This is a fully remote opportunity for an experienced property management professional to take ownership of a diverse portfolio and its day-to-day operations. You’ll serve as a key point of contact for clients and tenants, building strong relationships while ensuring properties are managed efficiently. The role combines operational oversight, communication, team coordination, and independent problem-solving. You’ll be expected to navigate complex situations that may not have straightforward answers, using sound judgment and a proactive mindset. Starting with a portfolio of around 100 units, you’ll have the opportunity to scale toward 150, 200, or more units as your performance grows. It’s an ideal environment for an adaptable, resilient professional who thrives on responsibility, fast-paced work, and continuous improvement. Serve as the primary point of contact for client and tenant communications, managing relationships professionally and ensuring timely, effective responses. Oversee the day-to-day operations of an assigned property portfolio, maintaining high standards of service and operational performance. Manage a portfolio that may range from approximately 70 units for standard performers to 350 units for top performers. Handle daily communication workflows, primarily through written correspondence and email, with occasional outbound phone calls. Take ownership of portfolio growth, with an initial target of approximately 100 units and the opportunity to scale to 150, 200, or more units based on performance. Coordinate workflows and oversee team performance, including supervising, guiding, and holding Virtual Assistants accountable. Identify and resolve unusual or complex operational issues that may fall outside established procedures, manuals, or FAQs. Apply critical thinking, initiative, and sound judgment to determine appropriate solutions in ambiguous situations. De-escalate conflicts with clients and tenants calmly and professionally while maintaining positive relationships. Adapt quickly to changing priorities and operational demands while maintaining a high level of service and attention to detail. Requirements: Previous professional experience in property management, particularly as a Leasing Agent, Property Management Assistant, Property Manager, or in a comparable property operations position. Demonstrated ability to oversee daily property operations, workflows, and team performance. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with confidence managing clients, tenants, and team members. Experience supervising, guiding, delegating to, and holding Virtual Assistants or remote team members accountable. Strong critical-thinking and problem-solving abilities, with the confidence to make sound decisions when situations are complex or solutions are not explicitly documented. Highly adaptable and resourceful, with a proactive, self-directed, and autodidactic approach to learning and problem-solving. Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced operational environment. Calm and professional approach to conflict resolution, with resilience and a consistently positive attitude. Availability to work U.S. business hours. A quiet, dedicated home-office environment suitable for professional calls and focused work. Reliable internet connection of at least 10 Mbps, with a backup internet connection available. Dependable electricity with a suitable power backup solution. Computer with at least an Intel Core i5 8th generation processor, AMD Ryzen 5, or equivalent. At least 8 GB of RAM, with 16 GB or more preferred. Windows 10 or higher or a compatible recent version of macOS. pineservices-pine-services:lever:fa0254b.title: SAP B1 Solutions Engineer Consultant (Presales)
pineservices-pine-services:lever:fa0254b.description: The Presales Solutions Engineer – SAP Business One plays a critical role in helping prospective customers envision the value of SAP Business One by designing tailored ERP solutions that address their unique business challenges. As a trusted advisor throughout the sales cycle, you'll partner closely with our sales team to understand customer objectives, analyze business processes, and demonstrate how SAP Business One and complementary solutions can transform operations. This role combines deep functional knowledge of SAP Business One with strong presentation, solution design, and consultative selling skills. You'll lead discovery workshops, deliver compelling product demonstrations, architect solution recommendations, and develop implementation strategies that align with customer goals. Working collaboratively with sales, consulting, and delivery teams, you'll ensure a seamless transition from prospect to customer while serving as the technical and functional expert throughout the presales process.
responsibilities: Partner with Sales to lead technical discovery sessions, uncover customer business challenges, and define solution requirements.
Design and architect SAP Business One solutions that align with customer objectives, industry best practices, and long-term business goals.
Deliver compelling, tailored demonstrations of SAP Business One and complementary solutions that clearly communicate business value to executive and operational stakeholders.
Develop solution proposals, scope recommendations, implementation approaches, and statements of work in collaboration with sales and consulting teams.
Serve as the primary functional and technical advisor throughout the sales cycle, confidently addressing customer questions and solution objections.
Recommend complementary solutions, integrations, and ISV applications that enhance the overall SAP Business One ecosystem.
Collaborate with implementation consultants to ensure a seamless transition from presales to project delivery through detailed solution handoffs and knowledge transfer.
Support RFP and RFI responses by providing solution design, technical expertise, effort estimates, and implementation recommendations.
Build and maintain reusable demonstration environments, presentation assets, and solution accelerators to improve presales effectiveness.
Represent the organization at customer meetings, webinars, trade shows, user groups, and industry events as a trusted SAP Business One subject matter expert.
Stay current on SAP Business One product enhancements, partner solutions, emerging technologies, and industry trends to continuously strengthen solution recommendations.
Foster strong relationships with prospects, customers, and internal teams while maintaining the highest standards of professionalism, collaboration, and customer service.
qualifications: 3+ years of experience with SAP Business One in a presales, solution architect, consulting, implementation, or functional leadership role.
Strong functional knowledge of SAP Business One, including core financials, distribution, manufacturing, inventory, purchasing, sales, and related business processes.
Demonstrated experience leading customer discovery sessions, designing ERP solutions, and delivering compelling software demonstrations to business and executive stakeholders.
Ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable SAP Business One solution architectures and implementation recommendations.
Experience supporting the sales cycle through solution design, technical presentations, proof-of-concepts, proposal development, and scope definition.
Familiarity with the SAP Business One partner ecosystem, including ISV solutions for manufacturing, warehouse management, eCommerce, EDI, CRM, business intelligence, and process automation.
Working knowledge of SQL, reporting tools, integrations, APIs, or related technical concepts is highly preferred.
Strong business acumen with the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Excellent presentation, communication, consultative selling, and relationship-building skills.
Proven ability to manage multiple sales opportunities, priorities, and deadlines in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.
Bachelor's degree in Business, Accounting, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field is preferred.
Self-motivated, collaborative, and passionate about helping customers solve business challenges through technology.
High integrity, professionalism, and a customer-first mindset.
Authorized to work in the United States.

summitwashholdings-summitwashholdings:le.title: Entry Ride Operator
summitwashholdings-summitwashholdings:le.description: IMPORTANT - REQUIRED NEXT STEP As part of our hiring process, all applicants are required to complete the Predictive Index (PI) Behavioral Assessment. The PI Behavioral Assessment is not a test, and there are no right or wrong answers. It helps us better understand your natural workplace preferences and behaviors. Please complete the assessment when prompted. Completion is required for your application to move forward in the review process. Benefits, and Perks - Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance - Flexible scheduling - Paid Time Off (PTO) - Career Growth based on Performance and not Seniority – 75% of employees were promoted within Summit Wash Holdings - Referral Bonus up to $800.00 per qualified hire, dependent on position - Free Car Wash Membership Who are we? Summit Wash Holdings is a premier group of car wash brands growing throughout the Northeast, Midwest, and Southeast regions. At Summit Wash Holdings, all teammates produce speedy service in a fun and mutually respectful manner with gold-standard integrity, quality, and hospitality, all while maintaining a work-life balance. Our Mission is to provide a fast, quality car wash with friendly-spirited engagement and integrity. What do we need? The Entry Ride Operator is the conductor and entertainer for our members while making sure all vehicles are being processed safely and efficiently into the car wash tunnel. The Entry Ride Operator interacts with all customers and is responsible for exterior site cleanliness and creating a memorable experience in all interactions while preparing the vehicles prior to entering the car wash tunnel. A successful candidate would love working outdoors in all conditions and will be excited to roll up their sleeves to get the job done! You must be highly motivated, have an outgoing, and a friendly personality. We will provide extensive hands-on and online training for all team members.
responsibilities: Speak/Sing into microphone or headset
